_comment: Simulated clinic directory (spec §3.2). No real person and no real
credential is represented here. The tokens are fixture strings that exist
so the authentication path can be exercised offline; a real deployment
replaces SimulatedIdentityProvider with an adapter to the clinic's own
identity provider and no token ever reaches this process.
Every row exists to make one branch of §3.2 reachable. The five licensed
roles of §4.13 are the happy paths; the last three are the refusals, and
each is refused for exactly one reason so a test cannot pass by accident.

staff._why: spec §3.2 — a shared clinical account. Holds a licensed role and a valid credential, so sharedness is the only thing wrong with it. Refused because every clinical-review call must be auditable to a named individual.

spec §3.2 item 3 — in the directory, but not in a clinical role. Authenticates; is not a clinician. Refused with role: null rather than by naming a non-clinical job title, because the ClinicalRole enum has no member for one.
spec §4.13 — a genuine credential past its validity. Drops to the system role, never to patient.
